profile.summary: KoyoSE is a mid-level JavaScript developer with specialized expertise in Chart.js, focusing primarily on frontend rendering and DOM manipulation. Their contributions demonstrate strong proficiency in fixing rendering issues (bars, axes, tooltips) and modernizing legacy jQuery code to vanilla JavaScript. While their experience is concentrated in frontend visualization and bug resolution, there is no evidence of backend, TypeScript, or advanced asynchronous programming skills. The developer shows a collaborative approach to debugging through jsfiddle demos and manual testing, indicating a practical, hands-on problem-solving mindset. Growth opportunities include exploring modern testing frameworks, TypeScript, and integrating Chart.js with modern frontend frameworks like React or Vue.
